runtime.execution: Default Python AgentLoop/app-server scheduler; experimental Rust pure state machine/Python hosts; local managed terminal readers and alternate native CLI surfaces
runtime.service_boundary: Owns selected shell sessions/file state and harness sessions; provider/tool-IO/MCP/connector/hosted teleport clients. Rust core emits actions; Python drivers own external effects.

summary: Dual coding harness with typed concurrent tools, real task child loops, projected compaction and hot configuration; experimental native protocol and replayable TypeScript orchestration give distinct design leads.

inspection.scope: Default entry/app-server/turn/request/dispatch/results/continuation, native file and both shell variants, child create/cancel, projected compaction/log/rewind/reload, teleport; bounded unified Engine/driver/model result/code-mode dispatch and configured child receipts; relevant source tests.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Both implementations substantial: default Python branch traced more completely; unified app-server host complete cancellation/resource/recovery machinery, connector/MCP/network executors, native Rust CLI/frontend, all code-mode builtins and multi-model child binding details not exhaustively audited. Bare unified defaults disable compaction/subagents/background, application config may enable. No reference execution.

actions.name: read_file / write_file / edit / grep
actions.lifecycle: awaited native tools or consumed IO backend
actions.authority: Model profile/tool selection and permissions; full grep executor not deeply traced.

actions.name: bash (legacy fresh process)
actions.lifecycle: fresh shell or IO terminal, timeout then finally group kill/reap

actions.name: bash (managed variant)
actions.lifecycle: persistent terminal job; soft timeout hands over ongoing process, hard abort kills
actions.authority: Model when selected available variant; variants do not imply every profile default.

actions.name: bash_output / bash_stdin / bash_sessions / bash_log_file
actions.output: cursor output/status/path; bytes written; session metadata
actions.lifecycle: ongoing terminal handles and log access; kill joins readers
actions.authority: Model selected tool family; log write means these logs are mutable, not immutable audit.

actions.name: task
actions.lifecycle: child independent loop inside awaited parent task; cancel interrupts and awaits child
actions.authority: Model with profile permissions, parent-shared grants.

actions.name: skill / todo / ask_user_question / exit_plan_mode / web_fetch / web_search
actions.input: skill name, todo action read/write, question, plan acceptance, URL/query
actions.lifecycle: native discovered catalog; individual network/question executors not exhaustively traced
actions.authority: Model under permission/profile and prompt invocation controls.

actions.name: run_typescript
actions.input: inline async main TypeScript and discovered tools namespace
actions.output: value/error/pending tool effects resumed through operation receipts
actions.lifecycle: new isolated V8 evaluation/replay at pending effects, bounded effects/ops/heap/watchdog
actions.authority: Model configured unified harness; ambient OS/network unavailable inside VM, provided tool handlers supply effects.

actions.name: subagent.spawn / subagent.list / subagent.wait / subagent.send_message / subagent.interrupt / subagent.stop
actions.lifecycle: send admission can steer running/start idle; operation-key ack and watcher
actions.authority: Model when feature configured; no assertion bare host exposes it by default.

actions.name: Engine create/restore/apply/inspect/checkpoint
actions.lifecycle: Rust serialized state advancement; Python host drives external action completion
actions.authority: Program author/runtime; checkpoint alone does not own provider/process termination.

actions.name: middleware/hooks/custom Python tools
actions.input: before-turn/tool/hooks; BaseTool modules in user/project paths
actions.lifecycle: Python programs construction/reload; sys.modules cache limits code refresh
actions.authority: Operator/program; model editing source does not automatically replace turn.

actions.name: compact / rewind
actions.input: extra summary instruction; prior user index/restore_files/inplace
actions.output: appended context boundary or fork/truncated history/file restoration errors
actions.lifecycle: summary snapshot then append; effective model projection; inplace rewind destructive
actions.authority: Operator/runtime; no native model original-audit restoration transaction traced.

actions.name: reload_with_initial_messages / switch_agent / config update
actions.lifecycle: generation guards stale prepare; live active-turn swap possible, old transport deferred close

actions.name: teleport
actions.input: prompt, hosted project/conversation IDs and packed/summary context
actions.lifecycle: checks/potentially pushes Git then starts hosted workflow; no main executable continuity
actions.authority: Operator; Git push requires service approval branch.

actions.name: SessionLogger.save_interaction
actions.lifecycle: serialized append or fsynced atomic rewrite, nonsystem only
actions.authority: Runtime/program; not comprehensive original event log.

filesystem.detail: Native typed filesystem/edit tools with permission hooks, delegated IO; checkpointer supports selected file rewind.

processes.detail: Legacy shell group kill/reap; managed terminal IDs/output/stdin/control/kill/soft handoff and reader manifests; transport-dependent behavior.

code_actions.detail: General Bash; experimental Rust dispatches replayable isolated TypeScript/V8 orchestrated external tools. Separate feature scopes.

persistent_kernel.detail: Persistent terminal process with stdin could host interpreter by composition; no native managed Python notebook namespace in traced paths. V8 evaluates replay rather than continuous kernel.

standing_database.detail: Session/checkpoint/task receipts and file logs persistent state; generic shared SQL/kernel service client not established.

workflow_programming.detail: Python middleware/hooks/custom tools; configured unified model TypeScript supports async external-tool programs with replay state/IDs.

multi_model.detail: Copied child config plus selected agent profile, multiple backend adapters/compaction model; not provider selection alone claimed live peers.

live_collaboration.detail: Legacy child runs during parent task with streamed progress; configured unified send steers running child/starts idle via receipts. Parent-child scope, not unrestricted authenticated IRC peers.

concurrent_work.detail: Python concurrent tool batch and child loop; managed background terminals, runtime directive tasks and separately gated title generation.

steering_interrupt.detail: Legacy cancellation cancels/awaits tool batch, closes provider stream and child interrupt wait; GeneratorExit path weaker; unified core interrupt is protocol action, host custody not fully audited.

turn_redefinition.detail: Middleware/hooks and TypeScript effects configure sophisticated programs; native core turn protocol still authored/compiled, no model live loop replacement.

compaction.detail: Default Python appends boundary with prior user/summary and selects effective projection, retaining previous messages; configured Rust supports checkpointed compaction state.

context_repair.detail: Prior normalized history retained after compaction, operator fork/rewind/file restore; inplace rewind destroys current old log. No model managed original-history repair traced.

original_audit.detail: Normalized nonsystem messages and some persisted typed results, but clipping precedes capture, logger can rewrite and provider raw payload/chunks omitted. Unified transitions/checkpoints are state receipts, not all original external evidence.

audit_query.detail: Session message/log file and Engine.inspect/checkpoint primitives; model terminal log read can inspect but also mutate its log.

hot_change.detail: Generation-based off-loop preparation and synchronous swap protect partial/stale config; active turn may adopt swapped objects and defer old backend close. Cached Python modules limit source hot reload.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Native checkpoint+explicit input cursor restores pending compaction/projection and state protocol; runtime data resume exists, no quiescent own provider/process outpost/recompile handoff proved.

remote_services.detail: Mistral/alternate backends, MCP/connector contexts, consumed tool IO and hosted teleport workflow.

self_improvement.detail: Editable owned programs, hooks and replayable TypeScript orchestrator support search; no governed harness autodroit research/refit loop traced.

complaints.detail: No state-rich model complaint/bead operation in inspected native catalog/loop/protocol; operator/telemetry events are not that contract.

authority.detail: Bypass execution, per-tool/profile grants, shared child permissions, sandbox no ambient effect access; caller handlers supply actual authority.

evaluation.detail: Concrete compaction append/focus oracle, hook-binding mock and native restored/live checkpoint/projected result comparisons; pure-state equality not external custody proof.

time_order.detail: Unified core explicit sequenced input IDs/action/operation IDs/determinism, plus runtime child-generation receipt admission; original external byte audit still limited.

strengths: Compaction boundary/projection preserves prior normalized messages.
Model-programmable replayable TypeScript effects routed by stable IDs separate from state-machine implementation.
Managed shell soft timeout transfers an ongoing handle with cursor/stdin/kill access.
Config preparation generation and synchronous commit reveal useful partial-update protections.

Bare unified defaults disable compaction/subagents/background, application config may enable. No reference execution.
